description: Listening over speaking can shift you to a new season quicker than speaking can #selfmastery #designyourlife #accountability
transcript: When I learned that I have two ears and one mouth for a reason, my life changed. I am not required to speak at all times. A majority of the time, my role is to listen. The more that I listen, the more that I am able to process my thoughts, process my intentions, process what I am producing to the external world. I do not always have to have a voice in everything, and that's important.
